generation.mode: built-in ImageGen whole-canvas generation with same-territory coast canon as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient or cast-shadow field is visible, but cliff-top planes are consistently lighter than vertical basalt faces. The aggregate metric cannot override the literal no-lit-side requirement.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent cliff-top benches count as buildable; exposed sea-cliff and gully faces count as steep; talus, broken margins, sea stacks, and the conifer gully make up the remainder.

crown.method: Median native-pixel outer-foliage width across all eight visible gully conifers, measured on the 1254 px source and scaled by 2560/1254; source widths 48, 50, 51, 52, 52, 53, 53 and 53 px.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Flooded the source-raster blue and teal sea from the north and east edges, grew a narrow pale-foam collar, closed pixel-scale gaps, and filled small enclosed wet speckles; the two sea stacks and one detached cove boulder group remain unmasked as terrain.

refusalReasons: The candidate violates the highest-priority lighting rule: repeated lighter cliff-top planes and darker vertical basalt faces reveal an upper-light convention.
The north edge contains 42.50% land rather than the required western 34%, an 8.50 percentage-point overshoot.
openRisks: Several cliff runs still retain a repeated vertical-column rhythm; their weathering is improved over candidate 1 but owner visual judgment is required against the no-regular-palisade rule.
The measured median crown is within the accepted territory band but close to its 5.2 m upper limit.
The water mask overlay follows the surf and cove wash at native resolution, but no pipeline bake was run because the task is quarantine-only.
